fee_notes: Technical Assistance Fee: $50,000 standard (traditional restaurants), $25,000 for non-traditional sites (limited seating, reduced term), may be waived in limited circumstances or under Pacesetter/New Groundbreaker programs. Additional required fees: Training Fee $5,000 (new to system), Background investigation reimbursement $500 per person.
raw_excerpt: Whether you are already part of the Wendy's system or are an existing Wendy's Franchisee, you must pay a Technical Assistance Fee of $50,000 for each Wendy's Restaurant at the time the Franchise Agreement is executed. A Technical Assistance Fee of $25,000 is generally applicable to non-traditional sites with characteristics like limited seating, a reduced Franchise Agreement term and unique real estate provisions. In some limited instances (like a reduced Franchise Agreement term or other unique circumstances), Quality may charge a modified Technical Assistance Fee or may waive the Technical Assistance Fee entirely.
